senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; חוּל) [turn, lot,] inheritance, right of succession.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 8:4">B. Bath. VIII, 4</cite> <he>אחד הבן ואחד הבת בנ׳</he> the same law of succession applies to sons and (eventually) to daughters (v.

Midr. Till. to Ps. V, 1 (play on נחילות ib.) על הנ׳ שנחלתם וכ׳ for the possession which you took from me, and for the possession which I took from you; a. fr.—Trnsf. the central sanctuary at Shiloh or at Jerusalem.

<cite ref="Tosefta Zevahim 13:20">Tosef. Zeb. XIII, 20</cite>; <cite ref="Zevachim 119a:12">Zeb. 119ᵃ</cite>, sq.; <cite ref="Megillah 10a:3">Meg. 10ᵃ</cite>, contrad. to <cite ref="M01742"><he>מְנוּחָה</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>נַחֲלוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 8:2">B. Bath. VIII, 2</cite> <he>סדר נ׳ וכ׳</he> the following is the order of succession (among relatives).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 117a:3">Ib. 117ᵃ</cite> <he>משונה נחלה זו מכל נ׳ שבעולם</he> this division of inheritance (after the conquest of Canaan) is different from all other successions; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 629:2">Yalk. Ps. 629</cite>, v. <cite ref="N00488"><he>נְחִילָה</he></cite>.
